passwords.note: A filler word plus a year: an easy pattern, but this exact pairing is rare.
Shadows is a plain dictionary word with no digits or symbols, so people reach for it constantly.
Emily plus "12" is a name-and-number pattern people reach for constantly, so it turns up everywhere.
Azerty is the French keyboard's top row, and "123" tacked on is a very popular habit.
"hello1234" is just a greeting plus the most predictable digit run, the first thing people reach for.
